stories.title: Family, friends honor fallen Arizona firefighter at Spartan Race
stories.summary: Nick Hutcherson, 27, along with three other firefighters, died while battling wildfires in Western Colorado.

stories.title: Seasonably cool weather ahead for Phoenix with a warming trend just around the corner!
stories.summary: Expect sunny skies and dry weather for Thanksgiving in Arizona.

stories.title: 2 people killed in crash in Phoenix, suspect accused of driving impaired, speeding
stories.summary: Phoenix PD said impairment and speed were factors in the crash. Adding that the suspect was fleeing a traffic stop by DPS when the incident occurred.

stories.title: 2 passengers walk away after plane makes emergency landing in neighborhood lake in Gilbert
stories.summary: The Gilbert Fire Department said neither of the passengers had any injuries after the plane went down near the Val Vista Lakes community.

stories.title: Road closures in place along Grand Avenue after deadly motorcycle crash, Peoria police say
stories.summary: Peoria police are investigating a crash involving a motorcycle and a car near Grand and Olive avenues.

stories.title: Tempe Town Lake reopens 3 weeks after record water releases, officials say
stories.summary: The City of Tempe reopened the lake after water testing showed improved water quality and a decrease in debris.

stories.title: DPS investigates deadly rollover crash on Loop 101 off-ramp near Thomas Road
stories.summary: One person has died after a single-car rollover crash Saturday morning, DPS says.

stories.title: Fire displaces guests at Phoenix motel, says fire department
stories.summary: The Phoenix Fire Department responded to the large motel fire Friday night. Fire officials said everyone had evacuated before they arrived.

stories.title: Arizona child abuse victims challenge church's protections under religious confession
stories.summary: The victims have now filed a petition to the U.S. Supreme Court for review.

stories.title: MCAO's new attorney gets drunk at after-hours training, is disciplined
stories.summary: The attorney was disciplined after he didn't conduct himself in a professional way, said MCAO. The training asked the attorney to drink alcohol.

stories.title: $11 million notice of claim to be filed against City of Phoenix over Ahwatukee data center project
stories.summary: Attorney Anthony Ramirez is preparing a notice of claim against the City of Phoenix. Here's what we know so far.

stories.title: Woman pleads guilty after allegedly leaving dead baby in Sky Harbor Airport trash can
stories.summary: Annie Anderson pleaded guilty on Nov. 20 in connection to the death of "Baby Skylar."
